changelog:
Initial release of Pincushion for OpenClaw.

- Stakeholders can drop visual pins on any live web page; each pin becomes a comprehensive agent work packet (including selector, screenshot, DOM, thread, and acceptance criteria).
- OpenClaw agents can read, claim, implement, and resolve these pins, automating the feedback-to-fix loop.
- Offers both local and cloud-synced operation (with or without a license key).
- Provides a no-install pin widget for stakeholders—no extensions or accounts needed.
- Tools include actionable pin retrieval, claim, fix/resolve, agent reply, and more.
- Includes options for project registration, collaboration integrations, and troubleshooting guidance.
